name: Teneo Protocol
steps: 1 Step 1 : Install the Community Node extension Add the Teneo Community Node extension to Chrome. The homepage also links to a Community Node page .
2 Step 2 : Run a node and earn Teneo Points Run a node through the extension to earn Teneo Points. The project also lists quests that move you up its leaderboard.
3 Step 3 : Try the Beacon beta app Download the app from Google Play , or for desktop as a Mac , Windows or Linux build. The project says the app earns Fragments and that it is in beta.
4 Step 4 : Check the homepage for updates Return to the Teneo Protocol homepage to see whether the project has announced a token, a claim or an end date. As of 27 October 2026 it names none of them.
what: The Teneo Protocol campaign rewards people with Teneo Points through the Community Node Chrome extension and with Fragments through the Beacon beta app. Teneo's homepage still asked visitors to take part on 27 October 2026 and gave no end date.
